MAGI.Settings.ServerUrl.Name: Server address
MAGI.Settings.ServerUrl.Hint: The address of the relay server, for example http://127.0.0.1:30001. Use the address that the players open.
MAGI.Settings.BridgeSecret.Name: Bridge secret
MAGI.Settings.BridgeSecret.Hint: The same text as MAGI_BRIDGE_SECRET on the server. The server refuses the bridge if the two are different.
MAGI.Settings.Enabled.Name: Connect to the server
MAGI.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Turn this on to join this world to the relay server. Only the Game Master tab makes the connection.
MAGI.Pairing.Title: Pair a device
MAGI.Pairing.Choose: Choose the character for this device.
MAGI.Pairing.Expires: The code is valid for one use, for about {minutes} minutes.
MAGI.Pairing.NoCharacters: This world has no character to pair.
MAGI.Pairing.NotConnected: The bridge is not connected to the server.
MAGI.Pairing.NoAnswer: The server did not answer the pairing request.
MAGI.Notify.Refused: The relay server refused the bridge. Check the bridge secret. {reason}
MAGI.Pairing.MenuHint: Open the dialog that makes a pairing code for one character.
MAGI.Pairing.NotReady: The module is not ready. Open a world with a supported game system.
